entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Power-hungry wizard of the Conclave of Mages who usurped Lord Ith and later survived in a ruby ring.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Wizards' order ruled by Ith then Mairsil; it fell after Ith's rampage.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Ruler of the Conclave, imprisoned by Mairsil in Barl's Cage and driven nearly mad.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: Watersilver artifact made by Barl that siphons mana from its prisoner.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Summoned by Ith; led Jodah to him.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Powerful young wizard who freed Ith and cured his mind; Mairsil's archenemy.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Church of Tal leader killed by Mairsil.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Faction whose army attacked the Conclave.

entities.name: Wand of Ith
entities.description: Used by Mairsil to drain Delphine's magical defenses.

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Event caused by Ith after his release.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Ice Age soldier who found Mairsil's ring and gained necromantic powers, serving Leshrac.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Master of Lim-Dul who cut off his hand with the ring.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Task mage and Jodah's confidant whose spark Jodah ignited, destroying Mairsil's soul within her.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker whose ancestor buried the ring under Vess Manor; corrupted by it via the Raven Man.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: Fragment of Lim-Dul's essence that corrupted Liliana.

entities.name: Mairsil's ruby ring
entities.description: Ring into which Mairsil imbued his life.

events.summary: Mairsil usurps Lord Ith and imprisons him in Barl's Cage.
events.quote: Lord Ith was the ruler of the Conclave until Mairsil usurped his power

events.summary: Ith summons a Rag Man, who leads Jodah to him.
events.quote: The Rag Man eventually led the powerful young wizard Jodah to Ith.

events.summary: Church of Tal army attacks the Conclave; Mairsil drains Primata Delphine's defenses with the Wand of Ith and stabs her to death.
events.quote: after draining away her magical defenses with the

events.summary: Jodah frees Ith, who destroys Mairsil before Jodah cures his mind.
events.quote: An enraged Ith destroyed Mairsil before Jodah cured his mind.

events.summary: Ith causes the Fall of the Conclave of Mages.
events.quote: Ith then went on to cause the

events.summary: Mairsil's essence survives in a ruby ring for 2,000 years.
events.quote: his essence survived for the next 2,000 years

events.summary: Lim-Dul finds the ring during the Ice Age and gains necromantic abilities in service of Leshrac.
events.quote: gained vast necromantic abilities thanks to the power of the ring

events.summary: Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dul's hand with the ring before Mairsil can take control.
events.quote: Leshrac, seeking extra power himself, cut off the necromancer's hand with the ring.

events.summary: Mairsil poisons Jaya Ballard's mind to make her betray Jodah, but Jodah ignites her spark and her ascension eradicates Mairsil's soul within her.
events.quote: Jaya's ascension , and the energies it released, eradicated all traces of Mairsil's soul within her.

events.summary: The ring reaches an ancestor of Liliana Vess, who buries it under the family estate; it corrupts Liliana as the Raven Man.
events.quote: it corrupted Liliana in the form of the Raven Man
